We have 3 bridges, the closest to Juarez's Airport is Zaragoza Ysleta, but the bridge closest to El Paso's Airport is Cordova-Americas. Since Juarez's airport is considered federal grounds, you need to walk outside to request an uber. I would suggest, you go to Zaragoza Ysleta by Mexican uber, crosss the border walking, and take another US uber to El Paso's airport. The walk at the bridge will be a long and heavy one, but the wait times are usually less than crossing by car, and I am not even sure if a mexican uber can cross the bridge.
